checks.lead: Martín de Porras Velázquez  (9 December 1579 – 3 November 1639) was a Peruvian, pharmacist, barber, nurse and lay brother of the Dominican Order. Born to a Spanish nobleman and formerly enslaved Black woman, he entered the Dominicans in 1603 and was known for his work on behalf of the poor, establishing an orphanage and a children's hospital. He also maintained an austere lifestyle, which included fasting and abstaining from meat.
